title: Oven-Braised Corned Beef with Cabbage, Potatoes and Carrots
summary: A classic braised brisket dinner, slow-cooked until meltingly tender then served with buttery potatoes, carrots and cabbage wedges.

ingredients.item: flat-cut corned beef brisket, rinsed, fat trimmed to about 5 mm
green cabbage (about 900 g), cut into 8 wedges

steps.title: Braise
steps.text: Oven 150°C, combine the 2000 g brisket, 950 ml stock, 950 ml water, 2 chopped carrots, celery, onion, 3 bay leaves, 1 tbsp peppercorns, 1 tbsp thyme and 1 tsp allspice in a casserole, bring to a simmer, cover and braise until a fork slides in easily, 4½-5 h.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: Move the brisket to a baking dish, ladle over 240 ml of the cooking liquid, cover with foil and leave to rest.

steps.title: Strain
steps.text: Strain the remaining liquid, skim off the fat and return it to the casserole with 40 g butter, 700 g potatoes and the 8 halved carrots, then simmer until just tender, 7-10 min.

steps.title: Cabbage
steps.text: Add the cabbage wedges, cover and simmer until all the vegetables are tender, 10-15 min more.

steps.title: Slice
steps.text: Slice the brisket against the grain about 5 mm thick.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Arrange the brisket with the vegetables, moisten with a little broth, season with ¼ tsp pepper and serve with the mustard.

tips: Make sure the liquid just covers the brisket before braising, topping up with water if needed, so it cooks evenly.
Skim the fat from the strained liquid before simmering the vegetables for a cleaner-tasting broth.
Slice the brisket against the grain for the most tender result.
storage: Store cooled brisket and vegetables separately in the fridge for up to 3 days and reheat until piping hot (74°C) before serving. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
